description: This file defines an abstract class 'HTMLPurifier_Strategy' which serves as a strategy interface for modifying or purifying tokens within the HTMLPurifier library. It specifies an abstract method 'execute' that must be implemented to process arrays of tokens based on configuration and context, enabling custom or extended HTML purification strategies.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Strategy
classes.description: Abstract class that defines the interface for strategies used to modify or purify HTML tokens within the HTMLPurifier library.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Abstract method to execute the strategy on a set of tokens, configuration, and context, returning processed tokens.
